list.name: Changes
list.comment: Added `_dead_physics` function to `player.gd` for handling player motion and behavior while in the dead state. Integrated it into the main physics process flow.

task.summary: Converted texture imports to `CompressedTexture2D` format for optimization.
Added `.gdignore` file and generated imported texture metadata files.
Migrated stage files to `format=3` for compatibility with Godot 4. Updated resource paths and added unique IDs.
Added development guidelines, context summary, and software design document for project standardization and future reference.
Migrated `wood.tres` TileSet to `format=3` for Godot 4 compatibility and restructured resources with atlas sources.
Refactored disease-related scripts for improved type safety, alignment with Godot 4 standards, and code readability.
Refactored particles and disease scripts to use `CPUParticles2D` for compatibility with Godot 4. Improved code readability and alignment with framework standards.
Refactored viewport-based UI scaling and positioning logic for improved consistency and compatibility with Godot 4. Added fullscreen toggle functionality using input events.

Refactored `TextWin` UI and animation logic to enhance compatibility with Godot 4. Added tween-based transitions, winner-focused animations, and confetti particle effects. Updated `CustomCamera` to include smoother transitions for game over scenarios.
Refactored `Disease` and player scripts to improve signal handling, modularity, and compatibility with Godot 4. Added countdown HUD for infection tracking and associated game event management.
Added `CountdownHud` script to manage infection countdown display, including UI setup, animations, and dynamic style transitions.
Added `.godot/editor/Fire.tscn-folding-0a5d60dd4ee9014671f7ddff23447b8c.cfg` for custom node and resource folding settings.
Added `MatchCountdown` script to manage pre-match countdown with animations, particle effects, and custom audio. Integrated into game flow and HUD configuration.

Implemented `ScoreHud` for dynamic score tracking and player highlight visualization, added `VictoryScene` for match-end celebration and leaderboard display, and integrated both into game logic with transitions and event handling.
Enhanced `player.gd` to improve infection logic with checks for player and target statuses, added safeguards for invalid states, and expanded `dead()` functionality to include `isDead` state.

Refactored `CountdownHud` and `MatchCountdown` scripts to improve UI setup, anchor handling, and pivot logic. Simplified code by using `set_anchors_and_offsets_preset` and ensuring consistent scaling, rotation, and positioning.
Added `_dead_physics` function to `player.gd` for handling player motion and behavior while in the dead state. Integrated it into the main physics process flow.
